text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Respecting your partner, that's the basis of business dealings. The moment you looked down on us, the possibility of coexistence with you was crushed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手を敬うこと、
それが
商談の基本ですもの。
私どもを見くびった時点で、
あなたとの共存の可能性は潰えましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: It's a shame that we finally met after a long time... but we couldn't even share a mug of beer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく久しぶりに会えたのに……
ジョッキも酌み交わせないうちに、
残念ね。

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text: How dare you... you mere human!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
小癪に……
人間風情がぁ！！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Your words are hollow, you are the one who is petty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お言葉ですが、
小癪なのはそちらです。

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text: What did you say!? You keep mocking me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにをぉぉぉ！？
どこまでもおちょくりやがって……！
